name: Swiffy Slider
description: Super fast and lightweight slider and carousel
project_description: Drupal integration of the Swiffy Slider JavaScript library. Provides three field formatters (entity_reference/entity_reference_revisions, image, and text) plus a Views style that render field items or view rows as a lightweight slider/carousel. Sliding, dragging and snapping are native browser behaviour (CSS scroll-snap) rather than a JavaScript animation loop, so the bundled JS is tiny and the slider works with touch, trackpad and assistive devices. Sliders are configured by pasting a permalink copied from the swiffyslider.com configurator; the module parses that URL's query string into CSS classes, data-attributes and style custom properties on the slider container. A global default configuration URL can be set at /admin/config/content/swiffy_slider, and each formatter or views style can override it.
